name: STRING
summary: Protein-protein interaction networks and functional enrichment for thousands of organisms: identifier mapping, networks, interaction partners, enrichment, annotations and homology.
notes: Keyless. Paths carry the output format first: /api/{format}/{method}.
STRING asks for one call at a time with about a second between calls, and for bulk work to download its files instead.
Map names to STRING ids with ids.map first; calls with resolved ids are faster and unambiguous. When no identifier resolves STRING answers 404.
string-db.org is the current development release; production code should pin a version host such as version-12-5.string-db.org (the version method reports it).
Multiple identifiers are newline-separated (%0d in a GET); very long lists exceed GET URL limits.

endpoints.name: Map identifiers to STRING ids
endpoints.summary: Resolve protein names or accessions to STRING ids with their preferred names.

format.description: Output format: tsv, tsv-no-header, json or xml.

identifiers.description: Protein names, synonyms, UniProt accessions or STRING ids; several are separated by a newline (%0d).

species.description: NCBI/STRING taxon id, e.g. 9606 for human.

echo_query.description: 1 to add the input identifier as a column.

caller_identity.description: Name of your tool or site, which STRING asks callers to send.
